final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, c.country AS country, SUM(cr.points) AS pts, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT cnt FROM s1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT s1.raceId, s1.country, s1.pts, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.a FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.cnt > s2.a AND s1.cnt >= (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM s3) ORDER BY s1.cnt - s2.a DESC
